additional_info.subject: ID0473116-DC/Si-D/GB- [MP / R4 170001889] Charger Errors Issue CRM:03288000159
additional_info.body:
Dear Jeanne,
Thank you so much for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, we reviewed the logs for the specified timestamp and identified the reported errors.
The error sent to the customer is a general emergency error, which is triggered when either the emergency-stop button is pressed or a door is opened. In such cases, the customer will receive a QA26 error.
Please verify the following to confirm whether the error is related to these conditions
Ensure that the emergency-stop button is released and not pressed.
Confirm that all doors are fully closed and properly secured.
If both checks are completed and the error continues to appear, we will proceed with further investigation and take the necessary steps to resolve the issue.
Please provide us with feedback as soon as possible.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
